answer_1.quote: Significant progress has been made in translating natural language text to SQL statements over the past few years.

answer_2.quote: Two standard metrics for evaluating the performance in this domain have been exact set match accuracy and execution accuracy.

answer_4.quote: We then presented these questions, along with the SQL queries generated by the methods as well as the ground truth SQL queries... to two annotators for labelling.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators had access to the database schemas and were tasked with identifying the queries they deemed correct for each question, without knowing which model generated which query or if the query was from the ground truth queries.
